name: Thunderhawk Wings
summary: Hunters bring Thunderhawk Wings to Camp Taurajo, where Jorn Skyseer receives them as proof of their strength, cunning, and endurance.

sections.title: Trophy of the Hunt
sections.body: At Camp Taurajo, hunters prize a pair of intact Thunderhawk Wings. Wind serpents, called thunderhawks by local hunters, strike swiftly from above. Tracking them across the open plains and taking their wings tests a hunter’s skill. For an initiate, returning with the wings proves readiness for the lifelong path of an accomplished hunter.

faq.answer: Thunderhawk Wings come from thunderhawks soaring over the ridges and plains of the central and southern Barrens, especially around Camp Taurajo.
Jorn Skyseer, a seasoned tauren hunter at Camp Taurajo, asks for the wings as proof that an initiate has mastered the savanna’s hunting rites.

faq.q: What does claiming the wings signify?
faq.answer: Bringing the wings to Jorn Skyseer completes a challenging rite of passage. It shows the hunter has the strength, courage, and patience to face fierce aerial predators.

angles.text: As a hunter, claiming a soaring thunderhawk’s wings marks a rite of passage. It tests your tracking, patience, and marksmanship against swift aerial beasts.
As a tauren, you honor the savanna’s spirit by harvesting these wings and showing respect for the Earthmother’s fierce creatures.
